verdict.rationale: Spending limits are a fair question for a usage-billed hosting platform, so the axis applies. No Netlify documentation in the pack describes a spending cap or a service suspension on overage. Community reports say the opposite: a $104k bill after a DDoS, users asking for a way to cap spend, and a commenter noting Netlify is transparent that 'there are no limits.'

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set hard spending limits to control my cloud costs
